kyle_devx: Quick heads-up: onboarding edge quickstart started failing after the recent exports-map change in sdk-js. Repro: fresh npm i -> deploy to CF Worker -> runtime throws unresolved import.
anika_sdk: What did we change?
kyle_devx: We moved to an ESM-first conditional exports map to prefer node import paths and add types. Example we shipped: ```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "node": { "import": "./dist/node/index.mjs" },
    "default": "./dist/node/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./helpers": "./dist/node/helpers.mjs"
}
```
omar_build: CF Workers / Deno / Bun edge don't honor the Node-only conditionals so resolution fails. We see: `TypeError: Failed to resolve import '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk-js/dist/node/index.mjs'`.
sara_types: I'm also seeing TypeScript path resolution fail in quickstarts: tsc can't find our d.ts because `types` key is nested inside the node conditional. Fresh install -> no global types.
anika_sdk: Two fixes: (1) Add non-node conditionals (worker/deno/browser) that point to an edge ESM build. (2) Expose a top-level ./types export so TS resolves types outside of conditionals. Suggested exports: ```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "worker": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "deno": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "browser": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "node": { "import": "./dist/node/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs" },
    "default": "./dist/node/index.cjs"
  },
  "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```
kyle_devx: Also a lot of our sample repos still use `require('@redwood/sdk-js')` which hits `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` when package.json is `type: "module"`. Need a CJS compatibility surface.
omar_build: Short-term we can ship a compat CJS bundle and set `exports.".".node.require` to the CJS entry, or keep `main` pointing to `dist/node/index.cjs`. That'll unblock older samples and faster onboarding.
ci-bot: :rotating_light: Canary run: onboarding-edge (branch: main) - 5/8 edge samples failed with unresolved import errors. Logs uploaded to ticket #1422.
sara_types: Can we add a CI quick test that creates a fresh npm project, installs the package, and runs both `node --input-type=module` import smoke + `tsc --skipLibCheck` to assert types are resolvable?
anika_sdk: I'll open a small PR to add the worker/deno/browser fallbacks, a `./types` export, and `node.require` target. Will also add a changelog note and the CI smoke.
kyle_devx: Thanks. I'll update the onboarding README with a brief compatibility section showing both `import` (preferred for ESM/edge) and a `require` workaround for CJS users.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: Created ticket #1423 for exports map patch and #1424 for CI matrix tests.
